Let your tongue shine with praise of Allah
Zilhaj Challenge.Arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ
Zilhaj Challenge.Translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. There is no god but Allah. And Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, and to Allah belongs all praise.
Zilhaj Challenge.Transliteration: Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, la ilaha illallah, wallahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahil hamd

Zilhaj Challenge.subTitle: Let your tongue shine with praise of Allah
Zilhaj Challenge.Translation: O Allah, forgive me, grant me wellbeing, and provide for me.

Zilhaj Challenge.subTitle: Let your tongue shine with praise of Allah
Zilhaj Challenge.Arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
Zilhaj Challenge.Translation: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Surely, all praise, blessings, and sovereignty are Yours. You have no partner.
Zilhaj Challenge.Transliteration: Labbaika Allahumma labbaik, labbaika la sharika laka labbaik, inna al-ḥamda wa ni‘mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak

Zilhaj Challenge.subTitle: Let your tongue shine with praise of Allah
Zilhaj Challenge.Arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
Zilhaj Challenge.Translation: So remember Me; I will remember you. Be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
Zilhaj Challenge.Transliteration: Fadhkurūnī adhkurkum washkurū lī wa lā takfurūn

Zilhaj Challenge.subTitle: Let your tongue shine with praise of Allah
Zilhaj Challenge.Arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
Zilhaj Challenge.Translation: O you who believe! Remember Allah with much remembrance and glorify Him morning and evening.
Zilhaj Challenge.Transliteration: Yā ayyuhā alladhīna āmanū uḏkurū Allāha dhikran kathīrā wa sabbiḥūhu bukratan wa aṣīlā

Zilhaj Challenge.subTitle: Let your tongue shine with praise of Allah
Zilhaj Challenge.Arabic: وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا
Zilhaj Challenge.Translation: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with complete devotion.
Zilhaj Challenge.Transliteration: Wadhkur isma rabbika watabattal ilayhi tabtīlā

Zilhaj Challenge.subTitle: Let your tongue shine with praise of Allah
Zilhaj Challenge.Arabic: لِيَشْهَدُوا مَنَافِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ فِي أَيَّامٍ مَعْلُومَاتٍ
Zilhaj Challenge.Translation: That they may witness benefits for themselves and mention the name of Allah on known days (Dhul-Hijjah).
Zilhaj Challenge.Transliteration: Liyash-hadū manāfiʿa lahum wa yadhkurū isma Allāhi fī ayyāmin maʿlūmāt

Zilhaj Challenge.Challenge: Increase in doing ALL good deeds
Zilhaj Challenge.subTitle: Extra Nawafil, Tahajjud, Sadaqah, kindness
Ask forgiveness, feel gratitude
Ask forgiveness, feel gratitude
Zilhaj Challenge.Translation: My Lord, forgive me and have mercy on me.

Zilhaj Challenge.subTitle: Ask forgiveness, feel gratitude
Zilhaj Challenge.Arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا
Zilhaj Challenge.Translation: O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly.
Zilhaj Challenge.Transliteration: Allāhumma innī ẓalamtu nafsī ẓulman kathīran

Zilhaj Challenge.subTitle: Ask forgiveness, feel gratitude
Zilhaj Challenge.Translation: All praise is due to Allah.

Zilhaj Challenge.subTitle: Ask forgiveness, feel gratitude
Zilhaj Challenge.Arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِجَلاَلِ وَجْهِكَ وَعَظِيمِ سُلْطَانِكَ
Zilhaj Challenge.Translation: O Allah, all praise is due to You as is befitting to Your Majesty and Great Authority.
Zilhaj Challenge.Transliteration: Allāhumma laka al-ḥamdu kamā yanbaghī li-jalāli wajhika wa ʿaẓīmi sulṭānik

Zilhaj Challenge.subTitle: Ask forgiveness, feel gratitude
Zilhaj Challenge.Arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
Zilhaj Challenge.Translation: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. You are the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful.
Zilhaj Challenge.Transliteration: Rabbi ighfir lī wa tub ʿalayya innaka anta at-tawwābu ar-raḥīm

Zilhaj Challenge.subTitle: Ask forgiveness, feel gratitude
Zilhaj Challenge.Arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
Zilhaj Challenge.Translation: My Lord, forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day of Reckoning.
Zilhaj Challenge.Transliteration: Rabbi ighfir lī wa li-wālidayya wa lil-muʾminīn yawma yaqūmu al-ḥisāb

Zilhaj Challenge.subTitle: Ask forgiveness, feel gratitude
Zilhaj Challenge.Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلاَنِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
Zilhaj Challenge.Translation: O Allah, forgive all my sins, the small and great, the first and last, the open and secret.
Zilhaj Challenge.Transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lī dhanbī kullahu, diqqahu wa jillahu, wa awwalahu wa ākhirahu, wa ʿalāniyatahu wa sirrahu

Zilhaj Challenge.subTitle: Ask forgiveness, feel gratitude
Ask forgiveness, feel gratitude
Zilhaj Challenge.Arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
Zilhaj Challenge.Translation: Glory and praise be to Allah, as many times as the number of His creations, His pleasure, the weight of His throne, and the ink of His words.
Zilhaj Challenge.Transliteration: Subḥānallāhi wa biḥamdihi ʿadada khalqihi wa riḍā nafsihi wa zinata ʿarshihi wa midāda kalimātihi
